'''Ezar Elasra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]], Ezar Elasra was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], achieving the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Master Elasra took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], being placed in command of a small, but successful [[Battle group|battlegroup]]. Operating aboard the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Solidarity (Venator-class)|''Solidarity'']], a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that patrolled the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], Elasra was responsible for keep the peace in several sectors.<ref name="GAW" />

Tasked by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] with retaking the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] from the Confederacy, Elasra developed a plan to recapture the world, by having a strike team activate a planetary [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] and then using it against the orbiting CIS [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. He summoned a group of Republic agents to the ''Solidarity'' and on their arrival, tasked them with reactivating the cannon. The agents were successful in activating the cannon and when it began opening fire on the Separatist fleet, Elasra brought his battlegroup out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near the planet, beginning the [[Battle of Tirahnn (Clone Wars)|Battle of Tirahnn]].<ref name="GAW" />

About thirty minutes into the battle, Elasra contacted the Republic agents via a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and gave them a new assignment. He asked them to place some [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]] on a group of CIS [[Ground Armored Tank]]s that were threatening Republic forces. He also said that he would send a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to take custody of CIS [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zolghast]], whom the agents had captured. Shortly afterwards, Elasra boarded his [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] and led a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] in the space battle. Meanwhile, in his absence, the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] CIS [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Braxus Lyn]] disguised herself as Elasra and freed Zolghast from Republic custody. This caused a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] to believe that Elasra had defected to the Separatists, so the Republic agents were sent to recapture Zolghast and stop the false Elasra. The Republic forces were eventually victorious and captured the planet; and Elasra commended the Republic agents for their actions during the battle.<ref name="GAW" />
